lessons.goal: 整合事件順序與規則更新，推論合作失誤原因。

questions.evidence:
A plant beside the classroom window receives water from two students on the same morning. Both believe they are following the care plan. Taro points to a paper sign assigning Mondays to him. Nia shows a newer message assigning that day to her.

The class had changed the schedule after Taro joined an early practice, but nobody removed the old sign. Nia assumed the message had reached everyone. Taro rarely checked the chat before school and relied on the sign beside the plant.

The teacher asks the class to compare the plans rather than blame either student first. They choose one shared record beside the window and write the date of each update on it. Chat messages will announce changes but direct readers back to that record. Taro crosses out the old assignment, and Nia marks today's watering as completed. The next helper can now see both who is responsible and what has already been done.
questions.explanation: 兩人各依紙條與新訊息中的不同排班。
options: Neither has seen any instruction.
They follow different versions of the plan.
The teacher requested two waterings.
They are competing for a prize.
questions.prompt: Why do both students water the plant?

questions.prompt: Why mark today's watering as completed as well as name the helper?
